results.title: What TN college students need to know amid federal loan changes
highlights: At MTSU, Smitty estimated that 25% of undergraduate students who received federal student loans were enrolled less than full-time. For graduate students, that number comes out to 67%.

results.title: The Disappearing Student Safety Net
results.author: Joshua Bay
highlights: The analysis is based on data from [Trellis Strategies](https://www.trellisstrategies.org/)’ most recent [Student Financial Wellness Survey](https://www.trellisstrategies.org/research-studies/student-financial-wellness-survey-fall-2025/) of more than 65,000 undergraduate students across 153 institutions nationwide. It found that the share of students receiving emergency aid fell from 44 percent in fall 2021 to 4 percent in fall 2025—a decline of roughly 90 percent.
